moving_frontier_policy.breaking_private_change: Topology changes require a compatibility adapter or a new snapshot lane in Plectis.
moving_frontier_policy.private_frontier: Private #249/#257 work is excluded until a new manifest row and release gate promote it.
moving_frontier_policy.public_snapshot: A tagged standalone export remains runnable even when private proof work advances.
moving_frontier_policy.refresh_candidate: A newer validated source snapshot creates a new export candidate rather than mutating old tags.

publication_boundary.plectis_repo_publication: separate dissemination gate consumes the standalone tag/hash and Plectis receipts

snapshot_lineage.last_good_public_source: Plectis-side lineage, not the moving private root

dependency_pin.why: Palomar accepts a Mathlib revision only if it is an ancestor of mathlib4 master. The private v4.29.1 tag commit is a toolchain bump on a side branch (1 ahead, 4196 behind master); its parent is the v4.29.0 tag commit on master with identical Lean sources. First canary 1rwlfskltakg failed on exactly this, 2026-09-01.
